title: A STRONGHOLD IS NOT CLEARED BY PLAYER 2 TAKING OVER THE RAID
why: Cloud robustness hunt. Player 2's window keeps the host's strongholds from the world word, but only their place, gate and state: the defender lists stay in the host window. When the host window goes and player 2 picks up the raid (his ruling), a compound that was breached and not yet cleared had empty defender lists, so on the next frame it counted nobody alive, said STRONGHOLD CLEARED and paid the 1,000 chip with every defender still inside. Proven in headless Chromium on v27.30 (CAREER seed 1, compound 0 breached, 11 defenders alive): the compound rebuilt from the host word (as player 2 holds it), one frame of the raid run from that window, and it read cleared with the score 0 to 1,000 and 12 live bodies inside the fence. The same happened to a compound breached after the takeover: the second wave was listed but the garrison inside was not. Now a compound taken from the host counts the machines standing inside its fence as its garrison (never a pillager or the Overseer), once, the first time it is open, so it clears when they are down. The host's own compounds are unchanged.
now: When player 1 leaves mid-raid, a stronghold that was still being fought is no longer marked cleared and paid at once.
